typecheck.note: Java compilation serves as typecheck; included in the build task

lint.note: No separate lint tool configured; compilation warnings checked during clean build. Only pre-existing 'unchecked or unsafe operations' note in sdk-core (generic type erasure), not a new issue.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Redundant detectOs() call in loadFromClasspath() — parses System.getProperty('os.name') twice. detectPlatform() already computes OS internally but doesn't expose it, so loadFromClasspath() must re-call detectOs() for filename resolution.

extractAndLoad() can throw UnsatisfiedLinkError from System.load() if extracted binary is corrupt, but loadFromClasspath() only catches FeagiSdkException. UnsatisfiedLinkError from System.load() bypasses System.loadLibrary fallback. Narrow edge case since this only occurs if classpath JAR has wrong-platform binary.

VAL-PKG-009 (fallback behavior), VAL-PKG-010 (thread safety), VAL-PKG-011 (full-path integration) lack direct unit tests. Component methods are individually well-tested but integration scenarios require mocking System.load/System.loadLibrary which is non-trivial.
Assembly descriptors use schema version 1.1.3 while maven-assembly-plugin is version 3.7.1. Schema 2.3.0 would be more appropriate but 1.1.3 is backwards-compatible and functional.

Test manually reconstructs resource path formula rather than using loader's internal method. Acceptable since the path logic is simple string concatenation, but would not catch drift if the formula changed.

appliedUpdates.description: Added native_jars command entry for gradlew :sdk-native:nativeJars, which produces platform-classified JARs. Multiple reviewers flagged this task as missing from services.yaml.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that native lib files in sdk-native/src/main/resources/native/ are text-based placeholders (not real binaries) that will be replaced by actual compiled Rust FFI binaries via CI. Workers should not expect them to actually load as native libraries.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature relocate-native-libs committed placeholder files (contents like 'not-a-native-library', 'placeholder linux-x86_64'). No documentation warns future workers about this.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document Windows cmd shell quoting friction: Workers should use simple commit messages without special characters, or use the git commit -m approach with single quotes inside double quotes. Multiple workers encountered git commit failures due to shell escaping.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature verify-pom-metadata worker had 3 failed git commit attempts before finding a working quoting approach on Windows cmd.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention note about idempotency patterns in FeagiNativeLibrary: loadAndVerify() throws IllegalStateException on double-call while loadFromClasspath() returns silently. Future workers adding new loading methods should follow the loadFromClasspath() pattern (silent return if already loaded) for user-facing convenience methods.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: FeagiNativeLibrary.java: loadAndVerify() throws on double-call, loadFromClasspath() returns silently. Two different patterns for the same class.

rejectedObservations.reason: Functional and backwards-compatible. Updating schema version is cosmetic and doesn't affect build behavior. Already noted as non-blocking issue.

rejectedObservations.observation: Internal API refactor opportunity for detectPlatform() to expose OS/arch components, avoiding redundant detectOs() call
rejectedObservations.reason: Code-level refactoring suggestion, not a shared state or guidance issue. Already captured as non-blocking issue on the feature.

rejectedObservations.observation: Temp script pattern (creating and deleting verification scripts) could be documented as acceptable
rejectedObservations.reason: Already works well. Documenting it would over-prescribe — workers naturally do this when needed.
